prompt: Use case illustration-story. Generate a single landscape 16:9 opening illustration for a Chinese first-grade literacy course called Sun, Moon, Bright. The cozy paper-and-light workshop is original and will sit in a picture-first lesson frame. A clean light wooden worktable with a few blank rectangular paper tiles and an illuminated small warm desk lamp. On the table one simple blank circular yellow paper cutout and one crescent-shaped indigo paper cutout lie side by side, the main focus, comfortably in the central 60 percent. Window light, cream paper background, warm honey, muted vermilion and deep slate-blue accents. Gentle two-dimensional hand-painted gouache on paper, distinct clean outlines and editorial children's book polish. Landscape with a straightforward eye-level view, subjects large and legible, calm uncluttered edge areas. No visible writing, glyphs, numbers, watermark, logo, UI, frames, or textbook cover. One whole illustration with no separate panels.
review: 暖色桌面中太阳圆片和月牙纸片对照清楚；台灯、空白纸片完整，无可见文字，主题区域居中。可用于封面与书写活动的开始页。
